title: About CounterCrave
description: Learn how CounterCrave researches countertop kitchen appliances and helps readers make better buying decisions.
summary: CounterCrave is an independent editorial website focused on countertop kitchen appliances. Our goal is to turn specifications, research and clearly disclosed testing into practical buying guidance.

sections.heading: What we cover
paragraphs: We focus on air fryers, blenders, electric kettles, toaster ovens, food processors and other countertop appliances.
Our pages are designed around real buying questions: size, capacity, power, cleaning, durability, value and suitability for a specific household.

sections.heading: How we stay useful
paragraphs: We separate verified facts from editorial judgement, explain important drawbacks, identify who should skip a product and link to primary sources when a claim needs support.
Hands-on testing is described only when it actually took place. Research-based content is labelled and reviewed before publication.

sections.heading: Affiliate relationship
paragraphs: Some links may be affiliate links. They may earn CounterCrave a commission without changing the price paid by the reader. Affiliate relationships do not change our editorial standards.

author: CounterCrave Editorial Team
